issues: The whole column is grey skeleton bars; even the stop row has no content, so 'today's is the big one' never reads
Light grey on grey: no light, no depth — any paused frame looks like a wireframe
Scrolling starts with a hard jump to peak speed on frame 14, with no anticipation
The stop row is only marked by a 1px dark outline; nothing lands after the brake
changes: Midnight dark stage with a Swiss-grid layout: a fixed left readout column (wordmark, 96px 'Changelog', 120px date readout) and a 1136px-wide scroll on the right
The scroll is a believable 2026 release log (version / title / type dot / date, three staggered row heights); the stop row is a publish-grade 64px v4.0 'Live Canvas' hero card
Rhythm rebuilt as a 10f 26px pull-back anticipation, a 54f fast-start long-tail brake (bezier .45,0,.06,1) and an 86f hold, with vertical directional blur driven by velocity
The date readout flips with whatever crosses the read line and smears with speed, then lands as an accent 'Today' on the brake frame
On the brake the hero row spring-lifts to 1.04 (one visible bounce) with an accent stroke, back glow and a single clipped sheen; other rows dim to 0.38 and soften into depth
The tail holds with a slow 2% push and breathing glow, ending on a complete launch poster
